Perfume.title: Perfume
Perfume.description: Represents a perfume item or decant in the store inventory.

image.description: Image URL or illustration of the perfume.

category.description: Fragrance category (men, women, unisex, decants, attar).

volumeOptions.description: Available stock volumes or decant options.

priceByVolume.description: Key-value pair mapping volume string to custom price.

stockStatus.description: In Stock, Low Stock, or Out of Stock.

isFeatured.description: Whether highlighted on the landing page.

notes.description: Array of scent notes (top, middle, base accords).

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer purchase order and shipping details.

district.description: Dhaka or Outside Dhaka for courier charge mapping.

items.description: Details of ordered perfumes, quantities, selected volumes, prices.

totalAmount.description: Total order amount including delivery charge.

paymentDetails.description: Metadata from the payment flow (e.g. Transaction ID, account number).

orderStatus.description: Pending, Packaged, Shipped, Delivered, or Cancelled.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents customer review rating and feedback left for a fragrance.

perfumes.description: Store database catalog of luxury fragrances and price variants.

orders.description: Customer perfume purchases for bKash/Nagad validation and fulfillment.

reviews.description: Verified purchase feedback reviews for various scents.
